subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): import legacy auth-profiles.json into SQLite store on load

question: Should legacy `auth-profiles.json` be imported during normal auth runtime loads, or must recovery stay in doctor/startup migration before runtime reads?
rationale: The reported auth loss is valid, but this patch crosses a credential-bearing persistence boundary where current policy, docs, and tests keep legacy JSON out of steady-state runtime loads.

options.title: Keep Runtime SQLite-Only
options.body: Rework the fix into doctor or an explicit startup/update migration that verifies SQLite persistence and handles legacy JSON cleanup before runtime reads.

options.title: Approve Runtime Import
options.body: Accept runtime import only with maintainer/security approval plus updated invariant tests, docs, and a stale-credential threat model.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Issue
options.body: Use the broader migration issue as the canonical place to decide automatic migration versus loud upgrade diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime SQLite-Only
recommendation.body: Rework the fix into doctor or an explicit startup/update migration that verifies SQLite persistence and handles legacy JSON cleanup before runtime reads.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the SQLite auth-store runtime boundary introduced in the auth persistence refactor.
